guidance.bestFor: The default size with minus at the start, plus at the end and the value centered between them

whenNotToUse.when: A value checked against a schema with an error shown under the control

guidance.bestFor: The sm size, a 28px tall group with tighter input padding for dense rows and toolbars

whenNotToUse.when: A row of standard 32px controls where the default height fits

guidance.bestFor: The lg size, a 36px tall group with wider buttons and roomier vertical input padding

whenNotToUse.when: A dense row where the control must stay 28px tall

name: c-number-field-4
title: Number field with buttons on right
label: Buttons on Right
description: Number field with buttons on right

guidance.bestFor: The value aligned left with minus and plus grouped side by side at the end of the field

whenNotToUse.when: Stacked up and down chevrons in place of a minus and plus pair

guidance.bestFor: Up and down chevrons stacked in a small bordered box at the end, with the value aligned to the start
agentNotes: The chevron box hard codes `rounded-lg`, so it stays rounded in styles whose group is square, such as lyra and sera

whenNotToUse.when: Separate minus and plus buttons side by side after the value

guidance.bestFor: A React Hook Form Controller binding the amount, with zod bounds, an error message and Cancel and Submit buttons
agentNotes: `onSubmit` only raises a `toast` with `data.amount` and resets the form; send the amount to your API there and mount the Sonner toaster
`FormSchema` requires 10 to 100 while `NumberField` allows 0 to 100 and starts at 5; align `min` and `defaultValues` with the schema

whenNotToUse.when: A standalone control outside any schema or submit flow
